use: Search over the question base of the interview trainer (T52): which bank question an interviewer means.
provenance: Written by the course author for this task before any retriever ran on it. For every bank question one query with its key term and one paraphrase that avoids it; the term queries of TECH04, TECH05, HR01 and HR07 repeat the searches the MCP planner made in T42 and T43. Eight queries ask for topics the bank does not cover.
